# Guardian

Product key: guardian
Aliases: Guardian by Evercraft, Guardian Pilot
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/guardian
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/guardian/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/guardian/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Evercraft Revenue War Map: When immediate stability needs are addressed, a user may choose longer-term private income planning. Guardian does not treat a modeled income plan as a substitute for urgent basic-needs resources.
- EverNest: Family and new-parent practical support can route to EverNest when the need is family coordination rather than provider/resource navigation.

## Use this capability when the user means

- I need help paying rent
- I need food help near me
- help with utility bills
- childcare assistance near me
- transportation assistance near me
- free or low-cost legal aid near me
- benefits or public resources I may qualify for
- find Spanish-language or interpreter-supported help near me
- find verified help for housing shelter food benefits transportation childcare income or legal aid
- find public safety or stability resources without creating an account
- find outside support when I do not want to route through my school workplace family or usual authority
- find prevention and protective infrastructure resources
- give my organization a privacy-minimized public doorway to verified help

## Authority

Public discovery and verified-resource navigation only. No emergency dispatch, provider admission, school operations, or guaranteed live capacity is implied.

## Boundaries

- not an emergency-response service
- does not guarantee provider availability or service acceptance
- does not claim universal staffed response, automatic counselor review, warm referral, live shelter capacity, or closed-loop referral confirmation unless a specific provider or deployment separately verifies that capability
- GuardianLink school operations are a separate authorized deployment lane
- private case data, precise locations, protected identities, and admin topology are not public

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
